title: v1.0.91 Beta — Upcoming Mocks Update
description: You're on the bleeding edge! This beta release brings a highly requested feature: the ability to schedule and track Upcoming Mock Exams.
features:
📅 Schedule Upcoming Mocks
Plan out your mock exams! You can now schedule upcoming mock exams, see a countdown on your dashboard, and keep track of them in your Planner.

⏰ Log Result Shortcut
When a mock exam date arrives, you'll be alerted and can log the result with a single tap, pre-filling the mock test form instantly.

📝 Smart Text Wrapping
Extremely long mock exam titles will now beautifully wrap across multiple lines without breaking your dashboard layout.

🤖 Pulse AI Enhancements
Continued improvements to the Pulse AI coaching algorithms and background stability.
